answer.rationale: Do not respond with promotional pricing: recovered source exp_73 shows its acquisition and qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline, conflicting with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Referral incentives are the only available direction with evidence of qualified revenue contribution and no measured retention harm, though their ability to directly reduce price-driven SMB churn is unproven. Use a guarded established-customer deployment rather than assume it offsets the competitor's cut; activation messaging can support value communication but has evidence only for early engagement, not churn prevention.
